notes: Lead profile: small HR SaaS that builds candidate screening + employee Q&A product. High read ratio for embeddings, chat used for contextual candidate replies.

Main ask: guidance on picking an open/affordable model on Hosted API — CTO explicitly: 'we need GPT-3.5-ish quality but cannot afford high per-token spend; want predictable latency for chat (p50 < 200ms for short prompts)'.

Models they're asking about: Llama (2/3) 7B variants, Mistral 7B/Chat, Qwen 7B. Questions: expected quality delta on short Q&A, recommended quantization/precision for hosted execution, warm KV cache behavior for repeating prompts.
Cost sensitivity: primary. Wants lowest-cost model that doesn't regress on hallucination risk for HR policy Q&A. Interested in balancing embedding costs vs chat costs (some hybrid approach?).
Performance targets: p95 latency under 800ms acceptable, preferred p50 < 200ms for first token; throughput moderate (~10 rps peak).
Security/compliance notes: must support SSO/SAML for internal admin, audit logs retention 6 months, optional KMS for keys. Data residency currently US only.

Trial results: self-serve run with free credits — ran small set of prompts against Mistral-7B-chat and Llama-2-7b-chat. CTO notes: 'Mistral felt snappier but Llama returned safer phrasing on policy edge cases.'

SE feedback (Riley): preliminary token-cost estimates attached in Drive doc; suggested Hosted API + prefix caching, start with Mistral-7B for cost/latency, fallback to Llama-2-13B-mini for difficult safety-critical prompts; provide eval harness to measure regression over their prompt set.
Quoted from CTO (paraphrase): 'We want something plug-and-play — minimal infra overhead. If Redwood can give clear cost delta and a simple fallback policy, we'll likely convert to paid quickly.'

Customer concerns: how Redwood handles automatic fallback routing, per-route token accounting, and impact of batching on tail latency. Also wants examples of quality vs price tradeoffs (e.g., sample outputs side-by-side for their prompts).
Requested assets: cost/quality comparison matrix, recommended model pins and rollout strategy, quickstart sample repo (node/python), and contract terms for SMB monthly billing.
